IS: 4483 (Part I)- 1968 

Indian Standard 

PREFERRED PANEL CUT-OUT 
DIMENSIONS FOR ELECTRICAL RELAYS 

PART I FLUSH MOUNTING IDMTL RELAYS 
0. FOREWORD 

0.1 This Indian Standard ( Part I ) was adopted by the Indian Standards 
Institution on 16 January 1968, after the draft finalized by the Relays 
Sectional Committee had been approved by the Electrotechnical Division 
Council. 

0.2 The requirements of electrical relays for power system protection are 
covered in IS : 3231-1965*; it, however, does not cover dimensional 
requirements. With the possibility of a number of manufacturers starting 
production of relays, it was kit that the cut-out dimensions also should be 
standardized to enable variety reduction and also interchangeability. Not 
only switchgear manufacturers but also users, some of whom are them- 
selves assembling switchboards incorporating relays, are expected to be 
benefited by the standardization of cut-out dimensions. It is expected 
that the future manufacturers would from the beginning line up with the 
dimensions specified in the standard. 

0.3 This standard ( Part I ) covers only flush mounting, both draw-out type 
and plug-in type IDMTL relays. The dimensions for other types of relays, 
if necessary, will he added at a later date. 

0.4 While preparing this standard the dimensions of relays already being 
manufactured in this country have been examined. 

03 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this 
standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, express- 
ing the result of a test or analysis, shall be rounded off in accordance with 
IS:2=l96Qf. The number of significant places retained in the rounded 
off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard. 



1. SCOPE 

1,1 Tliis standard (Part I) lays down the panel cut-out dimensions of 
flush mounting IDMTL relays. 

♦Specification for electrical relays for power system protection, 
f Rules for rounding off numerical values ( revised)* 



IS: 4483 (Part I) -1968

3,1 A tolerance of +£ mm shall be allowed on all dimensions.
